name: Paperless-ngx
description: Scan, index and archive your paper documents so you can search them

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database, the search index, the Redis queue and .secret_key, this install's own key made on first start. Back it up.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your documents: the originals, the searchable PDF copies and the thumbnails. Back it up.

paths.name: Consume
paths.description: The inbox. Drop scans and PDFs here (with the Files app or a network share) and Paperless picks them up on its own.

paths.name: Export
paths.description: Where the document exporter writes full backups.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Paperless-ngx web UI and API, published on host as 6748

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: USERMAP_UID
variables.description: The user that owns the files Paperless writes. It is filled in by MOS. Leave it.

variables.name: USERMAP_GID
variables.description: The group that owns the files Paperless writes. It is filled in by MOS. Leave it.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER
variables.description: The name of the first admin account, made on first start.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first admin's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used to create the admin; change the password later in Paperless itself.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE
variables.description: The language most of your documents are written in, as a three-letter code: eng, deu, fra, ita, spa. For two at once use deu+eng. Other languages also need PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGES.
